references.text: Pharaoh's confrontation with Abram after discovering that Sarai was his wife, not his sister, resembles Abimelech's reaction upon learning the truth about Isaac and Rebekah.
Abimelech confronts Abraham in a similar way to how he later deals with Isaac, having been misled regarding their relationships with their respective wives.
The question Abimelech asks Abraham about why he has brought them into danger mirrors the question he poses to Isaac in this event.
The same theological motif (Abimelech's innocence) appears in a parallel incident involving Abraham; it emphasizes God's protection of the righteous.
